title: Woman Runs Over Rooftops To Escape Police
description:
You're about to witness a chase in which multiple police officers had to run through the streets to catch a woman who had just committed a burglary. For a moment, it seemed like they had lost the suspect, until this happened. From the officers' conversation, it was clear that this wasn’t her first gig. While searching her, the female officer found multiple narcotics in her pants. The victim explained to the officer what happened. The woman had a previous warrant and was charged with criminal trespass, resisting arrest and her bail was set at $20,000.
